description: This file defines the RecipeRepository class, which manages CRUD operations for recipes and favorites in an Android application. It interacts with a Room database via a DAO and provides singleton access.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: Repository class handling recipe data operations and caching the singleton instance.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all recipe entities from the database.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for recipes matching the query; returns all if query is blank.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Gets a recipe by its unique ID.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Inserts a new recipe entity into the database.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a recipe by ID and updates the database.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the repository, synchronized for thread safety.
